# Druva

> Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Druva Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

---

## Organization Details

- Name: Druva
- Website: [druva.com](https://www.druva.com/)
- Founded: 2008
- Headquarters: 3062 Bunker Hill, Suite 101, Santa Clara, CA 95054, USA
- Phone (Americas): +1-800-375-0160
- Phone (EMEA): +44 (0) 20 3750 9440
- Contact: [Contact Us](https://www.druva.com/contact-us)
- Valuation: Over $2 billion
- Customers: ~7,500 globally, including 75 of the Fortune 500

---

## The Resilience Cloud for the AI Enterprise

### [The Resilience Cloud](https://www.druva.com/products/resilience-cloud)

The Industry's Leading SaaS-first Platform for Enterprise Resilience

Ransomware. Compromised Identity. Rogue AI. We run Resilience as a Service so your worst day is ours to handle and your business never stops.

- [Platform Overview](https://www.druva.com/products/resilience-cloud/platform-overview)
- [Pricing & Plans](https://www.druva.com/products/data-security-cloud/pricing-plans)

---

## Products

### [AI Resilience](https://www.druva.com/products/ai-resilience)

AI Resilience for the Modern Enterprise

- [Claude Backup] (https://www.druva.com/products/ai-resilience/claude-backup)
- [Microsoft Copilot] (https://www.druva.com/products/ai-resilience/microsoft-copilot)
- [Druva MCP] (https://www.druva.com/products/ai-resilience/druva-mcp)

### [DruAI](https://www.druva.com/products/dru-ai)

Ensure backup health and trends, accelerate troubleshooting using Agentic AI

- [Dru MetaGraph](https://www.druva.com/products/dru-ai/dru-ai-metagraph)
- [Dru SRE Agent](https://www.druva.com/products/dru-ai/dru-sre-agent)

### [Identity Resilience](https://www.druva.com/products/identity-resilience)

Unified protection for identity environments including Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory. Immutable security with identity-aware insights and orchestrated cyber recovery.

- [Entra ID](https://www.druva.com/use-cases/saas-apps/identity-resilience/microsoft-entra-id)
- [Active Directory](https://www.druva.com/use-cases/saas-apps/identity-resilience/active-directory)
- [Okta](https://www.druva.com/use-cases/saas-apps/identity-resilience/okta)

### [Data Resilience](https://www.druva.com/products/data-resilience)

Unified data resilience for cloud-native, SaaS, hybrid, and endpoint data. 100% immutability guaranteed.

- [Cloud Native](https://www.druva.com/products/data-resilience/cloud-native)
- [Data Center / Hybrid](https://www.druva.com/products/data-resilience/data-center-hybrid)
- [SaaS Apps](https://www.druva.com/products/data-resilience/saas-apps)
- [Endpoints](https://www.druva.com/products/data-resilience/endpoints)

### [Cyber Resilience](https://www.druva.com/products/cyber-resilience)

Bounce back from cyberattacks with data that is always safe and ready. Features AI-driven threat detection, automated malware scans, sandbox recovery, and Curated Recovery.

- [Accelerated Recovery & Response](https://www.druva.com/products/cyber-resilience/ransomware-recovery-and-response)
- [Security Posture & Observability](https://www.druva.com/products/cyber-resilience/security-posture-and-observability)
- [Threat Insights](https://www.druva.com/products/cyber-resilience/threat-insights)
- [Managed DDR (MDDR)](https://www.druva.com/products/cyber-resilience/managed-ddr)

### [eDiscovery & Compliance](https://www.druva.com/products/ediscovery-and-compliance)

Cloud-native SaaS for instant backup data search, legal holds, compliance monitoring, and data governance.

- [eDiscovery & Legal Hold](https://www.druva.com/products/ediscovery-and-compliance/ediscovery)
- [Compliance & Sensitive Data Governance](https://www.druva.com/products/ediscovery-and-compliance/compliance)
